technical.summary: Strong trend structure and volume spike present, but price remains below all key moving averages with bearish momentum indicators and cloud resistance—insufficient confluence for high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: TRMB shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 70 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (21/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction (small purchases by junior member 114 days ago) and absent recent news sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (382.8) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve provides minimal offset; 70-day earnings window adds moderate event risk to already hostile macro backdrop.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme fear sentiment (21/100) with ADX strong trend structure and 15x volume spike creates contrarian opportunity near support (63.31), but lacks fundamental or momentum confirmation.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below all major moving averages with bearish momentum (RSI, AO, PSAR), Ichimoku cloud resistance, zero insider/institutional conviction, elevated earnings risk, and VIX crisis regime (382.8) create hostile conditions that overwhelm technical strength.
